title: Discrepancy-Diagnostic-Agent Output
description: Discrepancy analysis result with severity status, probable causes, and investigation steps.

discrepancy_percentage.description: Signed percentage by which SSP undercounts relative to GAM. Formula: ((gam - ssp) / gam) * 100, rounded to 2 decimal places. Negative if SSP overcounts.

status.description: Severity classification based on absolute discrepancy: Normal (<10%), High (10-20%), Critical (>20%).

probable_causes.description: Ordered list of probable root causes. Always includes universal causes; expands with format-specific and status-specific causes. Video must reference VPAID/timeout/wrapper. Banner+Prebid must reference Prebid/timeout.

recommended_investigation_steps.description: 4-6 ordered, actionable investigation steps, from least to most invasive. Imperative form, specifying tool or location where applicable.
